final_draft.answer: Yes. New EBS disks in our AWS account (111122223333) are encrypted by default. A live check of that account on 2026-11-18 confirmed that new EBS disks are encrypted by default in the us-east-1 region.
final_draft.note: The approved disk-encryption answer (owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-18) names account 111122223333 but does not call it the production account. A separate approved answer, about root-account MFA, is what identifies 111122223333 as our production AWS account, so it is cited too. The live check covered one region only (us-east-1). Encryption by default is set per region in AWS, so this answer says nothing about other regions. A reviewer should confirm whether production uses any other regions before the answer is read as covering all of them.
